resources.string: Turns an external monitor into a separate display (no mirroring) on Xiaomi HyperOS 4 / Android 17: restores the hidden Desktop button and neutralises the mirroring enforcer.
Changes take effect right away. A reboot is only needed after installing or updating the module.
⚠ LSPosed did not provide a place to store the settings. Reboot and open this screen again.
⚠ The module is not active in LSPosed, so these settings can\'t reach the system. Enable it in LSPosed (scope: System Framework, System UI, Settings), reboot, then open this screen again.
Start the dock on the monitor
Opens the dock\'s desktop on the monitor when you choose Computer.
Apps to launch on the monitor after the dock, on connect. Package names separated by spaces or commas.
Turns it on when the desktop starts and off when you unplug, so the dock never shows up on the phone.
Turn off the phone screen in desktop mode
The phone stays awake. Press power twice, or Win+P, to get its screen back.
Use the phone as a touchpad

When the phone screen turns off in desktop mode, it stays black but keeps responding to touch: one finger moves the pointer on the monitor, tap to click, two fingers to scroll, two-finger tap to right-click, tap and then touch and move to drag. Three fingers or Win+P give you the phone back. Uses a little more battery than turning the screen fully off.
Higher = the pointer travels further for the same finger movement. Applied when you let go of the slider, even while the touchpad is on. The system\'s pointer speed and acceleration also apply.
Ignores the screen timeout in desktop mode. Turn this on if the monitor goes dark while you aren\'t using the mouse or keyboard. The power button still works.
Higher = bigger. 4K monitors usually look right between 240 and 360. 0 = the monitor\'s default; leave empty to never change it.
Enter 0 or a value between 100 and 800
Saved. Applied now if the monitor is connected, otherwise on the next connection.
Done — the module will not change this any more.
Logical resolution, e.g. 2560x1440 or 1920x1080. Lower = bigger UI and lighter on the GPU. 0 = native, empty = leave as is.
Only applied if the monitor reports it at the current resolution (e.g. 60). 0 = native, empty = leave as is.
Connect the monitor to pick from the modes it supports. Until then you can type them.
Hold Alt to see the open apps on the monitor and release Alt to switch. Off = switch instantly on each Tab.

The old version of HyperDesktop Unlock (io.maurizio.hyperdesktop, up to 1.12.7) is still installed. Uninstall it: with both enabled in LSPosed every hook would run twice. Then make sure this version is enabled in LSPosed (System Framework, System UI, Settings) and reboot.

Warning: \"Show on-screen keyboard\" is on while a physical keyboard is used. In some apps on the monitor the letters you type only show up after you lock and unlock the phone (Delete and Backspace still work).
Couldn\'t change it: turn off \"Show on-screen keyboard\" in the physical keyboard settings
Keep apps below the monitor\'s status bar (experimental)

Some apps (a browser\'s tab strip, for example) draw under the status bar on the monitor, and the bar covers their top. On = app windows on the monitor start below the bar; full-screen videos stay full screen. Applies to apps opened after you turn it on.

Alt+Tab · Alt+Shift+Tab — switch apps on the monitor
Print Screen · Win+Shift+S — screenshot of the monitor
Win+Shift+Arrow — move an app between monitor and phone
Alt+F4 — close the app on the monitor
Win+D — show the dock's desktop
Win+Backspace — Back
Win+1…9 — focus the Nth app
Win+P — phone screen on/off
You are on the latest version (v%1$s).
Update available: %1$s — tap to open Releases.
Could not check for updates — tap to open Releases.
Swipe from the left or right edge of the phone towards the centre to go back on the monitor, like on the phone. Turn it off if it gets in the way when you move the pointer from the edges.
With the touchpad on, tapping a text field on the monitor shows the on-screen keyboard on the phone, below the touchpad. With a physical keyboard connected Android doesn\'t show it.
Quick Settings: edit the tiles in the notification shade to add \"Monitor\" (Computer ↔ Mirroring) and \"Touchpad\".
Checking the module in the system…
Module running in the system (v%1$s), all parts attached.

The report contains your phone model, Android and HyperOS version, these settings, the module\'s recent log lines and, if a monitor is connected, the apps and window titles open on it. Nothing is sent by itself: you choose to copy or share it.
Report copied: paste it into the GitHub issue
